newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR EASES FURTHER ON IMPORT PRESSURE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR EASES FURTHER ON IMPORT PRESSURE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed weaker on the key U.S. dollar on Tuesday as importer demand for foreign currency continued outweighing the export inflows.
"The market is maintining its short trend and it was a bit hectic towards the end of today's session with almost every bank rushing in to buy," one dealer said.
"I'm not quite sure which client is causing this shortage and the central bank didn't do anything (to support the local currency)," he added.

The local unit ended the day at 11.4150/4250 on the U.S. dollar, a one and a half cent loss over late Monday's 11.4000/4100 position and was also quoted weaker on sterling at 19.1400/1600 compared to 19.0810/1095, tracking the U.S. dollar's softness abroad.
It was, however, indicated firmer on the German mark at 6.3000/3300 from 6.350/3575 and against South Africa's rand at 2.4900/5100 compared to 2.4920/4940.
